hooks.command:
files=$(jq -r '[.tool_input.file_path?, .tool_response.filePath?, (.tool_response.bashEditDiff.changedFiles[]?)] | .[] | select(type == "string" and . != "")')
printf '%s\n' "$files" | grep -qE '\.(java|xml)$' && jvm=1
printf '%s\n' "$files" | grep -qE '\.(cpp|cc|cxx|h|hpp)$|(^|/)CMakeLists\.txt$' && cxx=1
[ -n "$jvm$cxx" ] || exit 0
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0
tasks=""
# Native first: libnada_t3.so has no Java to typecheck against, and a broken
# .so is a runtime crash rather than a compile error. All four ABIs, because
# armeabi-v7a is 32-bit and catches size_t/int64_t mixups arm64 lets through.
[ -n "$cxx" ] && tasks="$tasks :app:buildCMakeDebug"
[ -n "$jvm" ] && tasks="$tasks :app:compileDebugJavaWithJavac"
out=$(./gradlew --console=plain $tasks 2>&1) && exit 0
diag=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -E -A 3 '\.(java|xml):[0-9]+: error:|\.(cpp|cc|cxx|h|hpp):[0-9]+:[0-9]+: (error|fatal error):|^ *CMake Error' | head -60)
[ -n "$diag" ] || diag=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n '/^\* What went wrong:/,/^\* Try:/p' | head -30)
printf 'build FAILED (%s):\n%s\n' "${tasks# }" "$diag" >&2
exit 2
